western.temperament: Compassionate, romantic, imaginative, adaptable, creative, tender, intuitive. Shadow named in the same source: indecisive, moody, gullible, can slide into manipulation. Symbol: two fish tied by a cord, swimming opposite ways; in one Greek myth Aphrodite and Eros became fish to escape Typhon.
western.planet: Jupiter (traditional), Neptune (modern); Venus exalted in Pisces
western.modality: Mutable; twelfth sign; opposite sign Virgo

chinese.temperament: Observant, hardworking, resourceful, courageous, talented, frank, honest, loyal, keeps promises, lively in company. Shadow: expects to be listened to and gets agitated when not; can brag. Classical image: Han Ying's Hanshi Waizhuan credits the rooster with five virtues: civility (the comb), martial prowess (the spurs), courage, benevolence (calls others when it finds food), trustworthiness (keeps time without fail).
chinese.element: Metal (fixed); earthly branch 酉 yǒu. Years: 1957, 1969, 1981, 1993, 2005, 2017.
chinese.clash: Rabbit (Wikipedia also lists Dog as the harm pair and Horse as a punishment pair)

symbolism.culture: English trade name and Chinese alias
symbolism.meaning: The name mandarinfish refers to its colours, said to recall the robes of an Imperial Chinese mandarin. One Chinese alias says the same thing outright: 官服魚 guānfú yú, 'official-robe fish'. Aquarium-trade aliases include 七彩麒麟 qīcǎi qílín ('seven-colour qilin') and 五彩青蛙 wǔcǎi qīngwā ('five-colour frog'). The formal Chinese name is 花斑連鰭䲗 huābān liánqí xián. A court robe on a thumb-sized fish is a clean bridge to the Rooster's first virtue, civility, worn as the comb.

The mandarinfish and its close relative the psychedelic mandarin are the only two vertebrates known to make blue from a cellular pigment; the cells were named cyanophores (Goda and Fujii 1995). Nearly every other animal blue is structural, made by light scattering off crystals. Taiwan's National Museum of Natural Science notes the blue organelles gather and disperse inside the cell, shifting how deep the blue looks. We could not open the 1995 paper itself (bot wall), so cite it via Wikipedia or NMNS.

Pairs spawn at sunset at the same sites night after night. In a Palau field study, all 198 timed spawns fell between 16 minutes before and 18 minutes after official sunset; the pair rises slowly (7 to 12 seconds) about one metre, releases eggs and sperm, and drops back. A Rooster keeps time without fail; this fish keeps sunset.

No scales. The skin carries a thick mucus coat with an unpleasant smell, and a second cell type secretes toxins thought to repel predators. Wikipedia is more cautious ('debatably smelly and bitter slime'), so phrase it as reported.

Xunzi, 勸學 Quàn Xué: 青，取之於藍，而青於藍 qīng, qǔ zhī yú lán, ér qīng yú lán, 'blue is taken from the indigo plant yet is bluer than the plant'; the source of the idiom 青出於藍而勝於藍 qīng chū yú lán ér shèng yú lán. 藍 here is the dye plant 蓼藍 liǎolán. The page ties it to the cyanophore blue and labels the pairing as its own; that framing is honest and the source checks out.

No myth, totem or spirit-animal tradition about the mandarinfish itself was found in any non-blog source. Generic 'mandarin fish spirit animal' meanings online are invented. Mandarin duck 鴛鴦 yuānyāng fidelity lore belongs to the duck, not this fish.

fusion.temperament: Our reading: yin Metal feeding mutable Water. The Rooster half wants exactness, a schedule and a visible standard; the Pisces half moves by feel and shifts with the current. In this fish the two meet as a creature that looks like pure display yet runs on a strict clock: blue made in its own cells, a rise that happens within minutes of sunset, a coat that refuses touch.
fusion.gifts: Our reading: original style that does not come from copying; a sense of timing others call luck; quiet, constant work (the all-day picking at copepods) that makes the public moment look easy; loyalty to one partner at a time.
fusion.shadow: Our reading: the Rooster's need to be seen and heard, wrapped in Pisces evasiveness. Admired from a distance, hard to hold; the bitter coat goes up before anyone has done harm. Can mistake perfect timing for the only acceptable timing and miss a night out of pride.
fusion.love: Our reading: Venus is exalted in Pisces and the Rooster keeps promises. Slow, exact courtship; chooses one partner and rises with them, side by side, on a shared signal. Wants a partner who shows up at the same place at the same hour without being asked twice.
fusion.money: Our reading: Rooster industry with a Pisces soft spot. Earns steadily through small, repeated effort; spends on beauty and craft; the risk is lending to a hard-luck story because the fish in you cannot say no and the rooster in you hates to look stingy.
fusion.conflict: Our reading: avoids the open fight and lets the coat do the refusing. When cornered, frank to the point of sting (the Rooster's bluntness). Do better by naming the problem at the first sign rather than going bitter.

best_matches.name: Whale Shark
best_matches.reason: Pisces x Dragon. Dragon is the Rooster's six-harmony partner (secret friend), and both are Pisces. The vivid small one and the vast gentle one share a sea.

best_matches.name: Slow Loris
best_matches.reason: Scorpio x Snake. Snake is in the Rooster trine (Ox, Snake, Rooster), and Scorpio is a fellow Water sign. Both carry a defence you only meet up close.

best_matches.name: Asian Elephant
best_matches.reason: Cancer x Ox. Ox completes the Rooster trine; Cancer is Water. Steady memory meets exact timing.

best_matches.name: Shoebill
best_matches.reason: Capricorn x Ox. Ox trine, and Capricorn Earth is the classic complement to Pisces Water. A patient, still partner for a fish that moves on a clock.

best_matches.name: Pangolin
best_matches.reason: Taurus x Snake. Snake trine; Taurus Earth complements Water. Armour beside slime: two animals that protect a soft body differently.

hard_matches.name: Penduline Tit
hard_matches.reason: Virgo x Rabbit. Rabbit and Rooster are a traditional six-clash pair, and Virgo is Pisces's opposite sign, so both systems pull apart at once.

hard_matches.name: Moon Jellyfish
hard_matches.reason: Pisces x Rabbit. Same Western sign, so it feels familiar, but the Rabbit-Rooster clash sits underneath.

candidate_lines: Your blue was made in your own cells, and you can tell a borrowed colour from across the lagoon.
Twenty minutes either side of sunset is your whole window, and you would sooner wait for tomorrow's dusk than rise in the wrong light.
Someone admires you through the coral and reaches out, and the bitter coat does the refusing so your face never has to.
All day you pick at the reef, one copepod at a time, so the rise at dusk can look like it cost you nothing.
A court robe on a fish the size of a thumb: you carry rank lightly and see no reason to explain it.
When you choose, you rise one metre with one partner, side by side, on the same signal, and then let the current carry the rest.

fact_audit.fact: Header hanzi 鴛鴦鰧 yuānyāngténg (rail__han and serial-han)
fact_audit.note: Not a Chinese name for this fish. 鴛鴦 yuānyāng is the mandarin duck (a literal calque of 'mandarin'); 鰧 téng is a bottom-dwelling stargazer-type fish. The dragonet character is 䲗 xián. Correct formal name: 花斑連鰭䲗 huābān liánqí xián. Shorter real alias that fits the page's theme: 官服魚 guānfú yú ('official-robe fish'); trade name 七彩麒麟 qīcǎi qílín.

fact_audit.fact: Blue comes from cyanophores, a mechanism found in almost no other vertebrate; most animals make blue structurally
fact_audit.note: One of only two vertebrates known to have cellular blue pigment (the other is S. picturatus). Name the second species rather than 'almost no other'.

fact_audit.fact: No red or orange pigment in the skin; the orange is structural interference
fact_audit.note: No source found for this. Wikipedia, NMNS and Animal Diversity Web discuss only the blue cyanophores. The claim looks like the cyanophore story inverted. Cut it.

fact_audit.fact: No scales; thick foul-smelling mucus containing toxins that deters parasites and predators
fact_audit.note: Scaleless, smelly mucus coat, and toxin-secreting skin cells are reported (ADW, Australian Geographic). Wikipedia hedges: 'debatably smelly and bitter slime' that blocks disease and probably discourages predators. Keep but soften to 'reported'.

fact_audit.fact: Most active at dusk, timed to the light that shows its colours best; moves through the coral's upper reaches in the last thirty minutes of light
fact_audit.note: It feeds continuously through the day, pecking small prey from the coral (Wikipedia, citing Sadovy et al. 2001). Dusk is spawning time: all 198 timed spawns fell within 16 minutes before to 18 minutes after sunset (Sadovy de Mitcheson et al. 2022). 'Timed to show its colours' has no source. Rewrite as: feeds by day, spawns within about 20 minutes of sunset.

fact_audit.fact: At dusk a male and female rise together in a vertical water column, release gametes simultaneously and descend, in open water above the reef
fact_audit.note: Pairs rise slowly (7 to 12 s) about 1 m, release gametes and return; spawning is in pairs at consistently used sites. Say 'about a metre' so it is not read as a long ascent.

fact_audit.fact: Lives only in tropical Indo-Pacific coral reefs and cannot survive outside this specific habitat
fact_audit.note: It lives in sheltered lagoons and inshore reefs, under foliose and dead coral, to about 18 m. It survives in home aquaria (hard to feed, shorter captive life of 2 to 4 years per ADW) and has been bred in captivity (NMNS references). Rewrite as 'sheltered lagoons and inshore reefs of the western Pacific'.

fact_audit.fact: Hero: 'wearing the most vivid coloration of any vertebrate alive'
fact_audit.note: Superlative with no source. Replace with the sourced fact (one of two vertebrates with cellular blue pigment).

fact_audit.fact: Hero: 'small enough to fit in a closed hand'
Proverb 青出於藍而勝於藍 (而勝於藍 tiles), tied to the Year of the Rooster as the page's own pairing
fact_audit.note: Idiom derives from Xunzi, Quan Xue (青取之於藍而青於藍). Pinyin present on the tiles; the page labels the Rooster tie as its own. 藍 is the indigo dye plant, so 'indigo, blue' gloss is fine.
